The submodule `.claude/worktrees/naughty-banach-6581d5` also shows untracked content, though that's likely an artifact of a parallel worktree session rather than a deliberate change.

The diff is otherwise clean — no staged changes, no source-code modifications in `packages/`. The repo is accumulating marketing collateral, not code.
